pages.text: No shovel: sneak + right-click a snow layer or full snow block with an empty main hand. Pick up drops. Four snowballs pack into one block in the 2×2 inventory grid.

pages.name: Igloo: 24 blocks
pages.text: 2×2×2 inside: four floor, four roof, sixteen walls. Leave a two-high entrance, then close from within.

pages.title: Construction
pages.text: Use existing snow drifts and slopes for some walls. Fill gaps. No workbench, wood, bedding, fire or shovel required. Ice is a poorer insulator.

pages.title: Check the room
pages.text: Close the entrance and open Room: it should report volume 8. Body heat warms the air gradually. Empty igloos do not heat themselves. Severe cold may still be dangerous.

pages.title: When snow is scarce
pages.text: If snow is sparse, dig a small cavity in soil or a drift and close its entrance with full blocks. Do not spend the first minutes on a large house. Powder snow is not a wall.
